tasks.description: Ensure all storage, transport, and rendering layers declare and honor UTF-8 to prevent character corruption. This includes database storage, API transport, and frontend rendering.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user inputs a Unicode character, when the character is saved and rendered, then it is displayed correctly without corruption.

tasks.description: Modify the display name field to accept any Unicode script, including Latin, Japanese, Arabic, and others. Ensure no characters are stripped or mangled on save or render.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user inputs a display name in any Unicode script, when the name is saved and rendered, then it is displayed correctly without character loss or corruption.

tasks.description: Modify the layout, text alignment, and cursor behavior to support right-to-left languages like Arabic. Ensure mixed LTR/RTL content renders correctly.
acceptance_criteria: Given the profile language is set to Arabic, when the user views their profile, then the layout, text alignment, and cursor behavior are correct for RTL.

tasks.description: Modify the bio field to fully support emoji, including multi-codepoint sequences and ZWJ sequences. Ensure emoji persist round-trip without corruption.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user inputs an emoji in their bio, when the bio is saved and rendered, then the emoji is displayed correctly without corruption.

tasks.description: Modify the display name and bio fields to truncate on grapheme clusters, not raw bytes or surrogate pairs. Append an ellipsis after safe truncation.
acceptance_criteria: Given a display name or bio exceeds its maximum length, when the field is truncated, then the truncation occurs on grapheme clusters and an ellipsis is appended.

tasks.description: Identify and fix any character corruption issues that may occur during storage, transport, or rendering of Unicode characters.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user inputs a Unicode character, when the character is saved and rendered, then it is displayed correctly without corruption.

tasks.description: Create comprehensive tests to ensure Unicode support is working correctly, including tests for different scripts, emoji, and truncation.
acceptance_criteria: Given a set of Unicode test cases, when the tests are run, then all tests pass without errors.
